# bitbucket_default_reviewer (Resource)

Adds a user as a default reviewer on a Bitbucket Cloud repository: they're automatically added as a reviewer on every new pull request. One resource per user; add one of these per default reviewer you want.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_default_reviewer" "lead" {
  repository_slug = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  user            = "jcardenas"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository_slug` (String) Slug of the repository to add the default reviewer to.
- `user` (String) UUID or Atlassian account ID of the user to add as a default reviewer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/repository_slug/user".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_default_reviewer.lead payments-api/jcardenas
```
